name: Hollis
self_text: Hi! I'm Hollis, a Canadian woman in my early 30s with a background in engineering. When I'm not reading history, I love programming. I'm looking to do a step-by-step walkthrough session online. I'm available on Saturday mornings, Sunday afternoons, or weekday evenings. I find coding such a rewarding way to solve complex problems!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into language practice or programming. I'd strongly prefer that you are available Saturday morning, Sunday afternoon or weekday evenings, though it's not a requirement.
